experiment_data.hypothesis: SFT baseline: supervised finetuning on FOLIO data (500 steps, Qwen3-4B, same model as all GRPO experiments) to establish whether hacking patterns are GRPO-specific or general finetuning artifacts. Compare eval PR/ISR/hacking taxonomy against GRPO exec-only and exec+ISR conditions.
experiment_data.notes: SFT baseline with Qwen3-4B (same model as GRPO experiments). Replaces killed plan009-sft-baseline-s42 which incorrectly used Qwen2.5-1.5B. cuda:1, seed=42, 500 steps, FOLIO data (data/train_500_seed42.jsonl). Dream 审稿三档均指出缺 SFT baseline 是 gap。
